about_the_game:
Adventure into a mythical world where every aspect of nature has a corresponding spirit. You wake up with only fragments of your past life — guided by a friendly Kitsune, you are tasked to purify and tame wild spirits in order to build a ranch and make sure these spirits are properly cared for. 

Features:

Become a Spirit Rancher

A farming game where your crops are all alive! Need some vegetables? Feeding cabbage spirits will cause them to produce fresh cabbages for you to harvest. Need some iron? Then craft a pen of iron spirits to farm a fresh supply of iron! What’s more, each spirit hungers for a specific type of resource. 

Craft Ecosystems

By grouping different spirits together, you can create a food chain wherein one spirit’s produce becomes another spirit's food! Craft delicate ecosystems wherein spirits support and feed each other in a harmonious pyramid of production!

Explore the Spirit World!

Explore vast regions of this magically painted world — each area embodying a different season. Learn how to navigate the world of Spirit Rancher and find those special spirits that will not only help your ranch, but also empower you to unlock new areas of the game. 

Fuse with your Spirits

Venture into danger and fight a huge variety of spirits! With your trusty brush and magical talismans, capture spirits to bring back to your farm. You may also summon captured spirits to your side, using their magical and unique abilities to aid you in combat, ranching, and exploration!

Build relationships

Make friends with  different villagers — each based on different mythical creatures. Give them gifts, spend your time with them, celebrate festivals, strengthen your bonds, and if you choose to, you can even romance them! 

Unravel the Mysteries!

Embark on an epic quest to paint life back into the world! On your journey, you will need to make choices that will take root and eventually blossom into consequences which will affect the fate of the world.
